correctness.rationale: For n≥6 the underlying cycle has n+1 vertices. A maximal n-arrow multipath is a coherent directed Hamilton path because any opposite-arrow pair makes a directed 2-cycle and a spanning path has uniform orientation. Thus the only top (n−1)-simplices are n+1 clockwise and n+1 anticlockwise faces; the disjoint top-chain boundary kernels are primitive Z-cycles of the two embedded boundaries ∂Δ^n. CCS Theorems 2.8,2.10 (read) yield ν=floor((n−1)/2)−1 connectivity and exactly H~_q=Z^r and H~_(n−1)=Z², where q=floor((n−1)/2)+[4|n], r=3 iff n≡3(mod4). If 4|n, H~_(ν+1)=0 and simply connected Hurewicz upgrades π_(ν+1)=0, giving (q−1)-connectivity. Hurewicz represents an integral basis of H_q by q-spheres, together with the two geometrically included top spheres; the resulting homology isomorphism of simply connected CW complexes is a homotopy equivalence by homological Whitehead. n=6 finite direct enumeration independently found 477 faces incl empty, mod2 H~_2 rank1 and H~_5 rank2. This finite check is corroboration, not the unbounded proof.
